TaskTwoSummary: the median AUROC per event of LightGBM with one event left out is drought 0.81; extreme rain 0.55; freeze 0.86; hurricane 0.39
BenchmarkResults: In Task~1 (Table~\ref{tab:bench1}; 650\,520 test samples at 15 days and 458\,778 at 60 days, the same for every model), the NDVI RMSE [95\,\% interval] at 15 and 60 days is 0.077 [0.066, 0.087] and 0.142 [0.124, 0.162] for persistence, 0.101 [0.088, 0.114] and 0.100 [0.087, 0.115] for climatology, 0.064 [0.056, 0.071] and 0.089 [0.078, 0.101] for LightGBM, and 0.063 [0.056, 0.070] and 0.093 [0.078, 0.113] for the transformer. The mean-squared-error skill score against climatology at 30 days is 44\,\% [28, 55] for LightGBM and 45\,\% [29, 56] for the transformer on the temporal test set, and 43\,\% [18, 62] and 45\,\% [20, 63] on the withheld counties, where the RMSE of climatology is 0.101 against 0.099 on the temporal test set. In Task~2 (58 drought events, 58 extreme rain events, 46 freeze events, 12 hurricane events), with one event left out, the median AUROC per event [95\,\% interval over events] is the NDVI--MNDWI change rule: drought 0.64 [0.58, 0.71]; extreme rain 0.41 [0.32, 0.45]; freeze 0.44 [0.35, 0.53]; hurricane 0.51 [0.26, 0.62] -- LightGBM: drought 0.81 [0.76, 0.83]; extreme rain 0.55 [0.49, 0.62]; freeze 0.86 [0.79, 0.91]; hurricane 0.39 [0.25, 0.63]. With a whole event type left out, the median AUROC per event [95\,\% interval over events] is the NDVI--MNDWI change rule: drought 0.64 [0.58, 0.71]; extreme rain 0.41 [0.32, 0.45]; freeze 0.44 [0.35, 0.53]; hurricane 0.51 [0.26, 0.62] -- LightGBM: drought 0.35 [0.27, 0.51]; extreme rain 0.55 [0.50, 0.63]; freeze 0.75 [0.57, 0.83]; hurricane 0.52 [0.30, 0.63] -- the transformer: drought 0.43 [0.28, 0.54]; extreme rain 0.55 [0.49, 0.61]; freeze 0.50 [0.39, 0.70]; hurricane 0.48 [0.35, 0.59]. In Task~3 (4\,823 county-weeks in the temporal test set: 939 better, 2\,964 the same and 920 worse four weeks later), the AUROC of a worsening [95\,\% interval] is 0.76 [0.64, 0.86] for the transition climatology, 0.68 [0.56, 0.78] for LightGBM on the USDM history alone, 0.77 [0.68, 0.84] for LightGBM with the field evidence and 0.81 [0.72, 0.88] for attention MIL; the AUROC of an improvement is 0.73 [0.61, 0.84], 0.77 [0.67, 0.86], 0.78 [0.68, 0.86] and 0.74 [0.66, 0.82]. Adding the field evidence changes the AUROC of LightGBM by +0.09 [+0.03, +0.17] for worsening and +0.01 [-0.02, +0.05] for improvement. Macro F1 is 0.25 for no change, 0.37 for the momentum rule, 0.27 for the NDVI-anomaly rule, 0.39, 0.39, 0.40 and 0.32 for the four models above. Figure~\ref{fig:benchmark} summarises the results.
